methods.label: Melee (Pirates' Hideout)
methods.summary: Kill the aggressive pirates in the single-way Pirates' Hideout with any decent melee weapon.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dragon scimitar or any decent melee weapon
steps: Bring a lockpick and travel to the Pirates' Hideout in the deep Wilderness (level 54).
Pick the door lock (39 Thieving) and enter.
Kill the aggressive pirates with melee; carry only low-risk gear due to PKer risk.

methods.label: Zombie pirates (Chaos Temple)

Fire spells or any decent melee weapon
steps: Travel to the Chaos Temple in the low-level Wilderness.
Use a Salve amulet and fire spells or melee to kill the undead Zombie pirates.
These count towards the task and carry lower PKer risk than the Hideout.

body:
# Pirates

Pirates are a low-level Krystilia Wilderness task. The main assignable pirates live in the single-way Pirates' Hideout (Wilderness level 54); a lockpick and 39 Thieving are needed to open the door. They have poor Defence, so any decent melee weapon such as a Dragon scimitar kills them quickly. Zombie pirates around the Chaos Temple also count and are a lower-risk alternative: they are undead and 50% weak to fire, so a Salve amulet and fire spells boost damage. All kills must occur inside the Wilderness, and PKers are a constant risk - carry only what you can afford to lose.
